page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.8xlarge is a dedicated high-clock-speed virtual machine instance based on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. The instance configuration allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware resource provisions omit local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring block storage volumes to be attached over the network for system drives and data persistence. Graphic acceleration is not present, with zero physical or virtual GPUs provisioned. The platform provides a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 3.1 GHz clock rate provides enhanced single-thread performance compared to standard-frequency cloud offerings, while the memory density maintains sufficient capacity for demanding multitasking. Because there is no bundled local storage or accelerator hardware, operational expenditure remains aligned directly with CPU and memory utilization. This makes the instance suitable for compute-bound applications, continuous integration build pipelines, code compilation, and enterprise application hosting utilizing remote persistent storage.
